title: Teaching Material Metadata
description: Per EO-S1.1-001 v1.1. Base fields reused from Sprint AI-103's PMO-approved js/runtime/MetadataParser.js (Subject/Grade/Publisher/Version/Chapter/Unit/Difficulty/Tags/Author/CreatedTime/UpdatedTime); Keywords and Source are EO-S1.1-001's own additions. Every field must be present; unknown values are null (or [] for arrays) — never guessed or fabricated.

materialId.description: Stable id, assigned once on first analysis, e.g. tm_1

Source.description: e.g. 教科書/講義/考卷/教師補充教材 — the material's real, disclosed origin
